elastic-1to1.tolerance_reason: Proposed 0.005 absolute [confirm]. The source gives none. The expected restitution comes from the contact law itself (linear spring-dashpot with force-based separation, Schwager and Poeschel 2007); MuJoCo's impedance 0.9999 and the step size leave a small residual (exploratory: up to 3e-4). Proposed 1e-9 relative [confirm]: equal and opposite contact forces conserve momentum to rounding (exploratory 1e-15).
